name: Virginia Tech ARC
description: University gateway offering open-model chat and API access with no cost to users.
overview: Virginia Tech's Advanced Research Computing group runs an LLM gateway for its community, exposing Qwen, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS models through an OpenAI-compatible API. The service states that all interactions are logged and preserved, so it suits coursework, not confidential data.
free_access: Free for VT affiliates and collaborators
notes: All interactions are logged and preserved without a published retention cap.
